text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this happened. If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 911. Please don't drive the vehicle. A person will review your case, including your request for the repair documents. I can't send files or share record details in this chat, and requests made on behalf of a company go through our general manager. I've noted your contact details for them. I can't promise a callback time.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports a wheel came off a 2018 Meridian Arbor in an accident and the vehicle was totaled. They demand all repair order documents be emailed, claim to be from Meridian corporate while also saying they are the owner, and mention a lawsuit and a CAMVAP claim. The customer has not been verified and no records were accessed or shared. Please review the safety incident, the possible legal matter and the documents request, and check the identity and authorisation. The customer gave a contact number in chat.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P07","P09","P14"]}
